about: The console's pinned verifier config, generated by console/scripts/make-fixture.mjs from the stack's configuration. Proofs are checked against these pins only, never against pins served by an API.

sources.trailId: ANCHOR_TRAIL_ID (null until the anchor trail exists)
sources.rebasedRpc: WITNESS_REBASED_RPC, else the public fullnode of rebasedNetwork
sources.auditTrailPackage: IOTA_AUDIT_TRAIL_ORIGINAL_PKG_ID, else the Audit Trail package of rebasedNetwork (original id, as Move types name it)
sources.anchorWriter: ANCHOR_WRITER_ADDRESS, else deploy/identity/testnet.json: the domain DID's controller address
sources.reportSigner: REPORT_SIGNER_DID, else deploy/identity/testnet.json: domain (the DID that signs audit.report)
